name: google-sheets-docs
title_zh: 命令行直连官方表格与文档
tagline_zh: Drive 连接器改不动、浏览器太慢、文件没给你就摸不到？这个 Skill 走官方 API，命令直达。
tagline_en: Drive connector too limited? Browser too slow? This hits official APIs straight from CLI—only touches files.
desc_en: Use whenever a task involves creating, reading or editing a Google Sheet or Google Doc - a new sheet or document, cells, ranges, tabs, formatting, row groups. Works through the official Sheets and Docs APIs with a command line tool rather than the browser or the Drive connector, which is faster and cannot reach a file you were not given. Use it too when an edit through the Drive connector has fail
why_zh: 绕开 Drive 连接器的权限黑洞和浏览器渲染开销，用官方 API 做结构化读写，快且边界清晰。
why_en: Skips the Drive connector's permission fog and browser overhead—structured reads/writes via official APIs, fast and auditable.
limit_zh: 只认 Google Sheets 和 Docs，不碰 Slides、Forms。
limit_en: Sheets & Docs only—no Slides/Forms. Requires gcloud auth and file shared to service account. Formatting limited to API scope; no charts or image.
title_en: Edit Sheets & Docs via official APIs, CLI-only
